name: Cleansing of the Flesh (Thaumaturgical Ritual, Intermediate)

system.description: The ritualist spends a full night bled nearly dry within a tub or cauldron of purified water, diffusing any non-supernatural addictions or diseases out of his body along with the blood. This ritual may instead be performed upon a willing subject who opens his own veins into the water while the thaumaturge chants throughout the night. A vampire left with no blood afterward is ravenously hungry and should feed immediately to avoid frenzy.
